      "rationale": "Prevents potential busy loops in the socket polling loop caused by TCP urgent data and avoids doomed send attempts when receive backpressure pauses reads. As noted in commit a626b28980, 'select() can keep reporting a TCP urgent indication even when recv() has no data to read... disconnect to avoid a busy loop.'"

      "name": "rpc",

      "evidence": "Modifies src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h to handle socket exception monitoring on HTTP connections.",

      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Hardens the HTTP server against socket exceptions by immediately disconnecting connections on Windows when exceptional conditions occur. Commit a626b28980 and the description confirm this applies the socket polling fix to established HTTP connections."
    },
